entries.title: The > in the Crewmate tab's message box lines up with your words
entries.body: In a task card's Crewmate tab, the > at the start of the message box sat a little above the words beside it. It now sits level with them, and stays beside the first line as a longer message grows.

picture.alt: A task card's Crewmate tab, with the > in its message box level with the words Tell the crewmate what to do next
